readout_other: BOLD-fMRI during sonication; ASL perfusion; resting-state connectivity; MADRS, IDS-SR, GAD-7, PCL-5, CGI; SAFTEE adverse events; neuropsychological battery
direction_notes: Amygdala FUS changed perfusion (greater than S1 control and hippocampus), BOLD in vmPFC and rACC, and lowered right BLA connectivity with sensorimotor regions; symptom improvement did not differ between conditions.
safety_notes: No serious adverse events or MRI-detectable injury; more AEs after amygdala than S1 sonication (2.50 vs 1.11 events/exposure); one participant had protocol-defined worsening of depressive symptoms after amygdala FUS, resolving within 1 month.

timing.protocol_description: Each session included two applications of ten 30 s sonications (30 s on/off) separated by a brief break (<5 min), delivered inside the MRI bore; PRF 10 Hz, pulse width 5 ms.

Device output intensities before derating; domain (water or other) is not stated.
Derating at 0.3 dB/cm/MHz, not measurement or simulation.
Same device parameters stated once for all FUS; applied to the S1 control exposure as well.
No masking used; auditory cortex BOLD activation was examined post hoc.
